title: 📋 Order Status Guide: What Does Each Status Mean?
content:
If you are not sure what your order status means, this guide will help you understand where your item or parcel is in the process.

When you buy products from China through our website, your order may go through several stages: payment, purchasing, seller shipping, warehouse arrival, international shipping, customs clearance, and delivery.

Each status shows the current progress of your order or parcel.


🌟 Simple overview

Your order may go through these main stages:

  1. Submit order
  2. Pay for the product
  3. We purchase from the Chinese seller
  4. Seller ships to our China warehouse
  5. Item arrives at our warehouse
  6. You submit international shipping
  7. Warehouse packs and ships the parcel
  8. You pay the international shipping fee
  9. Parcel enters international transportation
  10. Parcel is delivered

You can check the latest status in your account at any time.


1. 🕒 Pending Payment

What it means

Your order has been submitted, but payment has not been completed yet.

What you should do

Please complete the payment if you still want us to purchase the item.

If payment is not completed within the required time, the order may be automatically cancelled.

Common reasons

  • You submitted the order but did not pay
  • Payment failed
  • Payment is still being processed
  • You closed the payment page before finishing payment


2. 💳 Paid

What it means

Your payment has been received successfully.

The order is waiting for processing or purchasing.

What you should do

Please wait for our system or purchasing team to process the order.

If the order stays in this status for too long, you can contact customer service with your order number.


3. 🛒 Purchasing

What it means

We are purchasing the item from the Chinese seller.

This means your order has entered the buying process.

What you should do

Please wait for the purchase result.

During this stage, we may need to confirm details with the seller, such as stock, price, color, size, or delivery time.

Possible situations

  • The product is available and can be purchased
  • The seller needs time to confirm stock
  • The selected option is unavailable
  • The price has changed
  • The product is out of stock
  • The order needs your confirmation


4. ✅ Purchased

What it means

The item has been successfully purchased from the Chinese seller.

What you should do

Please wait for the seller to ship the item to our China warehouse.

Important note

Purchased does not mean the item has arrived at our warehouse. It only means the item has been bought successfully.


5. 🚚 Seller Shipped

What it means

The Chinese seller has shipped the item to our China warehouse.

The item is now in domestic transportation within China.

What you should do

Please wait for the item to arrive at our warehouse.

Domestic delivery time depends on the seller’s location, courier service, weather, holidays, and other factors.


6. 🏠 Quality Checked

What it means

The item may have arrived at or near our warehouse and is waiting to be processed.

Warehouse processing may include:

  • Scanning the package
  • Matching the package with your order
  • Checking the quantity
  • Taking QC photos
  • Weighing the item
  • Updating the warehouse status

What you should do

Please wait for warehouse processing.

If the package has been delivered for a long time but is still not stored, you can contact customer service with your order number and domestic tracking number.


7. 📦Stored

What it means

Your item has arrived at our China warehouse and has been successfully stored.

What you should do

You can now:

  • Check warehouse photos
  • Review item information
  • Wait for more items to arrive
  • Submit the item for international shipping
  • Combine it with other warehouse items
  • Request extra services, if available

Important note

Warehoused does not mean the item has been shipped internationally. You still need to submit a parcel and pay the international shipping fee.


8. 📦 packaged

What it means

You have selected warehouse items and submitted them for international shipping.

The parcel is waiting for shipping fee calculation, payment, or warehouse processing.

What you should do

Please check the parcel details and complete the required steps.



9.✈️ Shipped

What it means

Your parcel has left our warehouse or has been handed over to the logistics provider.

What you should do

Please wait for the tracking number or logistics update.

Tracking may not update immediately after dispatch.



10. ❌ Cancelled

What it means

The order or parcel has been cancelled.

Common reasons

  • You cancelled the order
  • Payment was not completed in time
  • The item could not be purchased
  • The seller was unable to ship
  • The item was restricted or unavailable
  • Customer service cancelled it after confirmation

What you should do

Please check whether a refund is required or has already been processed.


Why has my status not updated?

Sometimes the status may not update immediately.

Common reasons include:

  • Seller has not shipped yet
  • Domestic courier has delayed updates
  • Warehouse is processing many packages
  • The parcel is waiting for flight or transit
  • Logistics provider has not scanned the parcel yet
  • Customs clearance is in progress
  • Local courier has not updated the tracking information
  • Holidays or peak season delays

A short delay does not always mean there is a problem.


What should I do if the status is stuck?

If your order or parcel status has not changed for a long time, you can contact customer service.

Please provide:

  • Order number
  • Parcel number, if available
  • Tracking number, if available
  • Current status
  • How long the status has not updated
  • Screenshot of the status page, if possible

This will help us check the issue faster.


Important notes

  • Order status and logistics tracking may not update at the same time.
  • Purchased does not mean warehoused.
  • Warehoused does not mean internationally shipped.
  • International shipping requires a separate parcel submission and shipping payment.
  • Customs clearance time depends on the destination country.
  • If the order shows Abnormal or On Hold, please check the notice and respond quickly.
  • Once a parcel is packed or shipped, changes may not be possible.
  • If you need help, please provide your order number or parcel number.


Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: My order says “Purchased.” Why is it not in the warehouse yet?

“Purchased” means we have bought the item from the Chinese seller. The seller still needs to ship it to our China warehouse.

Q2: My item says “Warehoused.” Will it be shipped to me automatically?

No. After the item is warehoused, you need to submit it for international shipping, choose a shipping method, and pay the international shipping fee.

Q3: My parcel says “Shipped,” but tracking has not updated. Is this normal?

Yes, this can happen. Some logistics routes do not update immediately after dispatch. Tracking may update after the parcel reaches a sorting center, airport, transit point, or destination country.

Q4: What should I do if my order is marked “Abnormal”?

Please open the order details and check the abnormal reason. If you are unsure what to do, contact customer service as soon as possible.

Q5: Can I change my parcel after it is submitted?

If the warehouse has not started processing it, changes may be possible. If the parcel is already being packed or shipped, changes may not be possible.

Q6: Why is my parcel stuck in customs clearance?

Customs may need time to inspect the parcel, review documents, or calculate duties and taxes. If customs or the local courier contacts you, please respond quickly.

Q7: My order was cancelled. Will I get a refund?

If payment was made and the order is eligible for a refund, the refund will be processed according to the order status, seller policy, and website rules.


Need help?

If you do not understand your order or parcel status, please contact our customer service team.

To help us assist you faster, please provide:

  • Order number
  • Parcel number, if available
  • Tracking number, if available
  • Current status
  • Screenshot of the issue
  • A short description of your question

We will help you check the current progress and explain the next step.
